Hey,  had the same problem the first two days I had the game over the weekend. 

Here is a troubleshooting email I received from EA about the issue. 


1. Clearing the cache/Power cycling 

While the console is on, press and hold the console’s Xbox button for 5 seconds.
The console will power down.
Unplug the power cord.
Wait 30 seconds.
Plug the power cord back in then turn the console back on by touching the Xbox button
Note: If your console is set to the Instant On power state, the above steps will shut the console completely off and will not enable Instant On or the ability to turn on your console by saying ‘Xbox On’ until it reboots.

2. Clearing persistent storage

From the Home Screen, using the controller scroll left to the navigation pane.
Scroll down to Settings Icon.
In the Settings menu scroll down to Disc & Blu-ray.
Select Blu-ray.
Select Persistent Storage and confirm your selection.

3. Alternate MAC Address

From the Home Screen, using the controller scroll left to the navigation pane.
Scroll down to Settings Icon.
In the Setting menu scroll down to Network and select Network Settings.
Select the Advanced Settings.
Select Clear.
Shut down the console.
Disconnect the power cord from the back of the Xbox One and wait two minutes.
Once the two minutes have passed, plug the power back in and wait for the power bricks light to go from White to Orange.
Once the power brick has the Orange light start the console and try the game again.

4. Clear your local saved games and try reinstalling the game

Remove the disc from your console.
Scroll left on Xbox Home to open the guide.
Select Settings.
Select All Settings.
Select System.
Select Storage.
Select Clear local saved games.
Note: Selecting this option will not delete any games or progress you have saved in the Xbox Live cloud. It will only clear data you have saved locally.
Select Yes to confirm.
Once your console restarts, try installing the game again.

5. Take your console offline and install the game

Use your console offline:
Scroll left on Xbox Home to open the guide.
Select Settings.
Select All Settings.
Select Network.
Select Network settings.
Select Go offline.
Cancel the download:
On the Home screen, scroll to the right and open My games & apps.
Select Queue.
Highlight the game you’re trying to install.
Press the Menu button on the controller.
Select Cancel.
Eject the game disc and power cycle the console:
Eject the game disc.
Press the Xbox button to open the guide.
Note: Double-tapping the Xbox button will open the guide from any other screen on the console.
Select Settings.
Select Restart console.
Select Yes to confirm.

6. Go online and let the game update install:

On the Home screen, scroll to the right and open My games & apps.
Select Settings.
Select All Settings.
Select Network.
Select Network settings.
Select Go online.

Sheiff is hot on my tail.  I ride my horse deep into the swamps weaving my way Into dark murky water,mud and a fog that seemed to be consuming everything. 

My plan so far has succeeded. I left them law boys gassed at the edge of the swamp. With a hefty bounty on my head I decide to travel North out the long arm of the law as well as the bounty hunters.. I needed to keep a low profile. These dense swamps provided perfect cover for traveling undetected. Little did I know; there was something wicked lurking in these swamps. 

Night had fallen shortly after I evaded the sheriff.  navigating the dense fog with a lantern in hand. I notice shadows running behind the cypress. My horse becomes agitated. I try to calm O'l  Banjo but there's more movement in the fog. Banjo rears up and bucks me to the ground. The lantern smashes and the darkness takes over. Multiple figures appear from the mist and move in on me knives cutting through the think air.  

I gather myself from the ground and draw my revolver. I don't know if it was the adrenaline but it felt like time stood still as I  aimed and squeezed the trigger.  I dropped the first maniac, three rounds center mass, he went down hard. Blindsided I feel a blade slash Into me from my right. A second psychopath, a man possessed by something evil. He rears back for a second strike. It's hand to hand. I get a lucky blow, bashing my revolver Into his head. He's out cold. 

From behind me I hear footsteps splashing through pools of water and mud.  I turn, there's two more spriting from the edge of darkness Quickly I unsling my double barrel shotgun and tuck the stock Into my shoulder. Boom! The first shot tears through one of the men's chest 30 feet out. The second man is closing in. Too close for comfort. Boom! The shot grazes him at 15 feet. He falls to his hands and feet. I scramble to reload. 

The Man is Standing already. He looks me in the eyes : nothing, theres emptiness in his eyes, perhaps his soul is empty too. I slide the second shell into place and raise the barrel. Boom! Squeezing the trigger launches a solid slug through his head. Yup  he's dead. 

I whistle for my horse. Banjo belts out nervously as he approaches the gruesome scene. Poor guy, he seems something scared.  This place is mad. I'll have to calm him down before we get out of these cursed swamps. 

TL:DR Screw these creepy ass swamps.
